sample_unit: breast ultrasound examinations (300-report error-enriched subset for report auditing)

links.outcome: LLM vs physician reader performance in report auditing; no human-with-AI arm
links.effect: Physician reader achieved 91.7% report-level sensitivity and 83.0% error-level recall without false positives; Gemini multimodal sensitivity 96.2% but false positives in 18/60 error-free reports.
links.quote: The physician reader achieved 91.7% report-level sensitivity and 83.0% error-level recall without false positives.

links.outcome: Comparison of LLMs against physician reader and physician-interpreted findings input
links.effect: Key-image input underperformed physician-interpreted findings input for malignancy (AUC 0.879 vs 0.971) and BI-RADS (AUC 0.887 vs 0.984).
links.quote: In the full cohort, key-image input underperformed physician-interpreted findings input for malignancy classification (AUC, 0.879 vs 0.971) and BI-RADS risk classification (AUC, 0.887 vs 0.984).

links.outcome: False-positive outputs from body-marker misinterpretation under multimodal input
links.effect: Gemini with multimodal input produced false-positive outputs in 18/60 error-free reports and 12/240 error-enriched reports, mainly from body-marker misinterpretation.
links.quote: Gemini with multimodal input produced false-positive outputs in 18/60 error-free reports and 12/240 error-enriched reports, mainly from body-marker misinterpretation.

unlisted_practices: Adding report-embedded key images to LLM input for radiology report error auditing

screen.reason: Evaluates multimodal LLMs for auditing breast ultrasound reports to detect workflow errors and assesses the specific impact/safety of adding key images versus text alone.

primary.practice: multimodal report auditing with embedded key images
